home.intro: A few questions, one per screen. Each one explains how to check the answer on your own bike, and “I don’t know” picks the most common answer for you.

describe.title: Describe your bike
describe.text: Brakes, drivetrain, wheels, pedals: the questions rebuild your bike, even if you do not know a single brand name.

inspect.title: Check every part
inspect.text: Tap a part on the 3D model to see what it is, then run a full or targeted checkup and note what is wrong.

repair.title: Fix, adjust, replace
repair.text: Step-by-step guides with the tools you need and their alternatives, and the right questions to ask before buying a part.

guest.title: No account needed
guest.text: Your bike, checkups and list stay saved in this browser. Create an account whenever you like: they will be imported into it.

actions.chooseFirst: Pick an answer, or “I don’t know”.

default.title: Default answer: {option}
default.reasonContext: It is the most common setup for a bike like this: {context}.
default.reasonGeneral: It is the most common setup.
default.later: You can change it at any time from the summary.

summary.title: Your bike

summary.caption: Your answers
